source_text: Deus ad Abimelech in somnis: mortis reus es. Innocentia cordis; restitue uxorem prophetam. Oratio Abrahae sanat.
pass_a_gloss: God to Abimelech in dreams: of-death guilty you-are. Innocence of-heart; restore wife prophet. Prayer of-Abraham heals.
pass_b_english: [[God to Abimelech in a dream: You are a dead man >> Bible:Genesis 20:3]]. Integrity of heart; restore the prophet’s wife. [[Abraham’s prayer heals >> Bible:Genesis 20:17]].
